cipher.summary: Upgraded `zod` from v3 to v4, fixed the resulting `z.record()` two-argument requirement and `invalid_string`→`invalid_format`/`PropertyKey` path-typing breaks in `SpecValidationSeam`'s adapter, and verified with a full `npm run check` + `npm test` (519 passed) + `npm run lint` + `npm run build` + `npm run verify` pass.
cipher.risks: Zod v4 deprecates (but still supports) chained string-format validators like `.url()`/`.email()` in favor of top-level `z.url()`/`z.email()`; those call sites were left as-is since they still typecheck and pass tests, but a future zod major version may require migrating them.
